name: roll ball pectoralis major clavicular
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the upper chest below the collarbone. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your upper chest below the collarbone while leaning on a wall or lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.
